Yara: Morning! Opening my first PR touching router debounce + a tiny unit test. Two quicks: preferred branch name + any absolute no-nos for early PRs?

Sam: Welcome! Branch: `feature/<TICKET>-short` is our default. No-nos: don't push large generated files, avoid committing vendor/binaries, and don't change infra configs without an RFC.

Jules: Also, keep logical scope tight. If you're touching runtime behavior and adding tests for it, one PR is fine. If you're changing public config shapes or proto/schema, split into schema PR then follow-up.

Yara: Got it. CI/lint concerns? My black/mypy fail locally.

bot-ci: Pre-commit hooks: black,isort,mypy,flake8. CI blocks merges on failures. Run `pre-commit run --all-files`. See CI: https://ci.redwood.example/job/2056789012

Sam: If mypy is noisy, try `mypy --exclude tests` to narrow locally, but fix the real errors before merging. We have `make dev-setup` to install hooks and `scripts/format.sh` to autofix some style.

Yara: Reviewers and labels?

Jules: Add one CODEOWNER for the path + one peer reviewer. Labels: `area/runtime`, `needs-review`. If this might affect latency add `needs-perf` and ping @eng-oncall.

Yara: Any expectations for PR description / rollback text?

Sam: Use the PR template. At minimum: short description, test plan (how to run locally), and rollback steps. Example rollback: "revert PR -> redeploy -> run `tools/cachectl purge --prefix=router:`". If perf sensitive, note which metrics to watch (p50/p95) and who to pager.

Yara: Anything about commit messages/merge strategy?

Jules: Commit messages: `area(scope): short summary` e.g., `router(debounce): reduce duplicate checks`. Squash small fixes on merge; preserve history for multi-step features.

Yara: One small oddity: my change touches an auto-generated file under `gen/` but it's just formatting. Should I commit?

Sam: Don't commit generated files unless you intentionally changed the generator or the schema. Run `scripts/generate.sh` locally; if CI shows diffs for generated outputs, fix generator or add a note.

bot-ci: Note: two flaky DB tests were observed on main yesterday. If you hit them, add `flake` label and ping @eng-oncall.

Yara: Thanks! I'll run pre-commit, push branch `feature/ENG-999-router-debounce`, open PR, and paste link here. Appreciate the help :heart:

eng-oncall: Happy to help if CI flakes. Tag `flake` and I'll rerun pipelines or advise on rerun flags.
